# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 20 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-19 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_bard_level19_widening.rs) to level 20 — the final remaining
# level within PF1's 1-20 character-level cap for this class row — as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice
# seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/performance posture from the level-1 through level-19
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The PF1
# Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-20 "Special" column reads "Deadly
# performance" — verified independently against two primary sources (a
# raw HTML parse of d20pfsrd.com's own class table, bypassing
# AI-summarization, and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror via
# ClassDisplay.aspx, both byte-for-byte identical: "+15/+10/+5 | +6 | +12 |
# +12 | Deadly performance"), with neighboring levels 18 ("Mass
# suggestion, versatile performance") and 19 ("Inspire competence +6")
# fetched in the same pass to rule out misattribution. Base attack bonus
# genuinely rises to 15 (20*3/4), while poor Fortitude stays 6 (20/3, an
# integer-division coincidence with level 19) and both good saves (Reflex,
# Will) genuinely rise to 12 (20/2+2, up from 11). Bardic Knowledge
# genuinely rises to 10 (max(20/2,1), up from 9). The Bardic Performance
# rounds-per-day pool genuinely rises to 44 (4+CHA+2*(20-1), up from 42).
# The Fascinate DC genuinely rises to 22 (10+20/2+CHA, up from 21), while
# the Fascinate affected-creature count stays 7 (1+(20-1)/3, an
# integer-division coincidence with level 19). Frightening Tune's DC (the
# same formula shape as the Fascinate DC) likewise genuinely rises to 22.
# Inspire Courage stays +4 (next tier at level 23, out of scope) and
# Inspire Competence stays +6 (no further tier defined within PF1's Core
# Rulebook) and Lore Master stays 3/day (no further tier defined). Inspire
# Heroics' flat save-bonus (+4), AC-bonus (+4), and target count (2) all
# carry over unchanged (the next target-count rise lands at level 21, out
# of scope). Soothing Performance carries over unchanged as a bounded
# grant-only identity record.
#
# The level-20 "Special" column's sole entry, Deadly Performance (the
# class capstone), is a genuinely NEW class feature whose named Will-save
# DC (10 + 1/2 bard level + Cha modifier) is the exact same formula shape
# as the already-grounded Fascinate DC and Frightening Tune DC, so only
# that flat DC magnitude is grounded — mirroring the Frightening Tune
# idiom exactly. No death-effect-resolution engine, no
# audible/visual-performance-requirement checking, and no range/targeting
# engine exists anywhere in this codebase, so none of that is fabricated.
# Only one new tier constant (BARD_DEADLY_PERFORMANCE_LEVEL) and its
# matching flat-DC explanation block are added: no new record type beyond
# the one new DC magnitude, and no new choice slot.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion or Mass Suggestion execution, no
# Dirge of Doom execution, no Inspire Greatness execution, no
# untrained-skill-use execution for Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master
# take-10/take-20 execution against any actual Knowledge check, no
# Soothing Performance healing/condition-removal execution, no Frightening
# Tune fear-resolution execution, no Inspire Heroics
# targeting/save/AC-application execution, no Deadly Performance
# death-effect-resolution execution, and no spontaneous known-spell /
# slot posture burden.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level20
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:20
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
